Every family goes through the same four steps, no matter which track they pick.
A real, live 30-minute class — no credit card, no obligation to continue afterward.
We match you to a class based on grade and track interest. Not the right fit? No pressure to book anything further.
Choose a single track, a bundle, or all-access, then pick times that actually fit your week.
Classes run mornings, afternoons, and evenings across time zones. Swap tracks freely between terms.
Twice a week for 8 weeks, with the same teacher and the same small group of up to 8 kids.
Missed a class? A recording is ready within a few hours, and the teacher recaps it at the start of the next one.
The final class is a live showcase where kids present what they built — parents welcome to watch.
A certificate follows by email within a few days. Attending the showcase live is optional but genuinely fun.
Every class runs about 50 minutes, structured the same way whichever track it is.
Warm-up & recap — quick catch-up on where last class left off.
Main activity — the actual building, experimenting, or practicing happens here.
Show & tell — kids share what they made and get quick feedback from the teacher and each other.

Every teacher is background-checked and classroom-trained before they lead a single class.

A short update lands in your inbox after each session, plus a full report at the end of term.
Max 8 kids per class — small enough that a teacher notices if someone's stuck or checked out.
Recordings are saved so you can see exactly what happened, any time you want to check in.
Questions or concerns go to an actual support line — not a bot, not a ticket queue.
